## Case format
```json
{ "case_id": "PUB-01", "today": "2026-09-01", "previous_month": "2026-07", "current_month": "2026-08",
  "clients": [ { "id": "C01", "name": "Khulna Motors",
      "measures": [ {"measure": "Sales", "last": "2.00", "current": "39.00"}, ... ] }, ... ],
  "alerts": [ {"measure": "Followers Gained", "direction": "below", "level": "579.00"} ] }
```
setting: a measure, a direction (above or below) and a level.
